text:
Maya (Design): quick check on Midnight Echo94 throwing this into the wild. focus: chart tiers, code tokens inline, and copy parity for actions.

Diego (Frontend): paste tokens please so i can run contrast lab locally

Maya (Design): tokens: base-bg #061017, surface #0c1621, code-bg #07131a, primary #ff8c4b, accent #52d0ff, highlight #cfa8ff, lowmuted #8f9fb0

Ruth (Product): glance: funnel gradients look nice but the retention chart layers wash out the middle series. we need clearer visual hierarchy for A/B rows

Sam (Design Eng): agree. accent #52d0ff reads well on bg but next-to highlight #cfa8ff there's low separation. could shift highlight toward mauve-blue or reduce lightness

Isha (Accessibility): a11y callout: primary (#ff8c4b) on surface (#0c1621) is ~4.2:1 for 13px labels. for legend text we need 4.5:1. prefer shifting primary slightly darker or increasing legend text size

Maya (Design): options: darken primary to #ff7a36, or keep color and bump legend to 13.5px. mobile constraints worry me with larger labels

Diego (Frontend): performance note: adding stroke outlines to canvas lines to boost contrast costs CPU. color change is simplest. what about #ff7a36? cheap to deploy

Sam (Design Eng): #ff7a36 tested in storybook looks good. i'll wire it to the theme var. also propose algorithmic palette for multi-series: base hue +/- 16/32 degrees with L clamp 42-68% and S clamp 46-78%

Isha (Accessibility): please add a storybook check that computes contrast ratios for every generated pair. flag pairs under 3:1 for graphical objects and 4.5:1 for text. we should fail CI on critical dashboards

Ruth (Product): copy: button labels inconsistent. see "Run" vs "Execute" in console and tasks. we should standardize to "Run" for immediate actions, "Execute" for scheduled jobs. sync to docs once decided

Maya (Design): will add copy table to the spec. small UX ask: inline code looks thin on surface. current inline token color is #ffd87a. on surface it feels washed; thinking of adding rounded bg rgba(255,216,122,0.08) plus 6px horizontal padding

Diego (Frontend): inline bg is fine. minimal CSS change. makes tokens accessible without touching syntax palette. for code blocks, code-bg #07131a is deep; maybe raise to #0b1a22 so blocks feel part of layout

Sam (Design Eng): raised code-bg to #0b1a22 in a local branch 94 removes isolation. also adjusted scrollbar-thumb to rgba(255,255,255,0.06) on hover for visibility

Isha (Accessibility): scrollbar contrast improvement good. also check focus ring: current ring 2px @ 28% alpha on dark is too subtle. recommend 3px @ 0.55 or use solid accent in high-contrast mode

Diego (Frontend): we'll set focus var to 3px at 0.55 and add prefers-contrast: solid #52d0ff fallback. note: need to ensure this doesn't clash on adjacent inset elements

Maya (Design): charts: propose increasing legend swatch size desktop 15px -> 18px, mobile 12px -> 14px. keep labels same size and add ellipsis tooltip on mobile longpress

Ruth (Product): that keeps mobile density. also prefer stable copy for tooltips; i suggested "Enable response caching to reduce latency for repeated prompts" instead of the shorter one

Sam (Design Eng): timeline: theme token delta + CSS vars ~1 day, chart generator + storybook tests 2 days, accessibility fixes 1 day. targeting end-of-week freeze.

theme-preview-bot: generated preview -> /comms/preview/2188002222/midnight-echo-v1.png

Maya (Design): preview looks close. @Isha can you run an audit on the preview image?

Isha (Accessibility): quick pass: found two legend color pairs in multiline chart that fall under 4.5:1 for 12px labels. dropping inline notes in the figma file with suggested hue shifts (+10deg, -8deg)

Diego (Frontend): once you drop figma notes i'll iterate. will also add CI rule that runs contrast check on generated palettes.

Ruth (Product): once frozen can marketing use the screenshots? we prefer consistent phrasing in CTAs before we hand off

Maya (Design): yes. i'll publish spec with final tokens, copy table, and the generator rules. will post assets here when done. thanks folks :sparkles:
